Describe three features of buildings found in a typical CBD.

The students decided to test the following hypotheses:
Hypothesis 1: The number of pedestrians decreases as distance from the centre of the CBD
increases.
Hypothesis 2: The height of buildings decreases from the centre of the CBD (station) to the edge
of the CBD.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The teacher split the students into groups of three to do their fieldwork along roads going
from the centre to the edge of the CBD.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:

fieldwork.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
The students did a pedestrian count at five sites along each road, about 175 m apart, to

the CBD increases.
In the space below, draw a recording sheet the students could have used at each site.
